the lymph protein concentration is not a reliable index of the interstitial fluid protein concentration, and that the colloid osmolarity of the lymph is not a reliable measure of the interstitial colloid osmotic forces.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we should be cautious in assuming that lymph protein concentration and lymph colloid osmotic pressures reflect those of interstitial fluid.
the colloid osmolarity of lymph and interstitial fluid is not the same.
